name: Icon lid open reveal
looks: A simple pill or square shape morphs into a small icon with a hinged lid. The lid tips open on an overshoot and a tiny glowing diorama scene sits inside it, small enough to feel like a peephole into another world, before the camera cuts to that world at full size.
build: The pill-to-icon morph tweens border-radius and width/height on power3.inOut; the lid rotates open from its hinge edge on back.out; the inner scene only starts playing once the lid passes a threshold angle.
sound: A soft mechanical click as the shape resolves into the icon, a creak on the lid opening, a faint ambient tone from the scene inside.
prompt: Morph a simple shape into a small icon with a hinged lid, tip the lid open with a slight overshoot, and reveal a tiny glowing scene inside it, like a peephole into another world, as a teaser before the next shot pays it off at full size.
